mcp.name: instadomain
mcp.description: Check availability, suggest names, and purchase domains. Handles Stripe checkout, OpenSRS registration, and Cloudflare DNS setup automatically.

tools.name: check_domain
tools.description: Check if a domain is available and get its price. Always call before buy_domain.

tools.name: check_domains_bulk
tools.description: Check availability of up to 50 domains in one call via RDAP.

tools.name: suggest_domains
tools.description: Generate domain name ideas from a keyword and check availability across .com, .io, .ai, .dev, .co.

tools.name: buy_domain
tools.description: Start purchase via Stripe checkout. Show user the price from check_domain first.

tools.name: get_domain_status
tools.description: Poll order status until registration completes. Returns nameservers and Cloudflare DNS API token.
